text:
Jun Park: Heads-up — I noticed the embedding example in the model catalog entry for `zephyr-mini-embed` still shows a 1024-dim vector but our latest build returns 768. Also the external bench link is 404. Can someone pick this up?
Alex G: On it. I'll update the example and add a note about dim changes across quant/variants. Will open a PR.
Samira: Thanks. While you're at it, can you also add a short compatibility note for edge CPU fallback? Customers hit a perf regression when quantized variant falls back to CPU.
Alex G: Good call. I'll add: "Compatibility: quantized-8bit variants may fallback to CPU on older AVX machines; expect 2-3x slower per-token latency."
Jun Park: Also add a tiny migration snippet for the SDK — folks using the old `embed()` call need to pass `model: \"zephyr-mini-embed-768\"` or they'll silently get 1024/trimmed vectors.
ProductEng: Can you paste the snippet you plan to include? I'll validate against the SDK tests.
Alex G: Paste below — quick one-liner + proper args: ```js
// old: client.embed(text) -> ambiguous model selection
const resp = await client.embeddings.create({
  model: "zephyr-mini-embed-768",
  input: ["hello world"]
});
console.log(resp.data[0].embedding.length); // 768
```
Samira: LGTM. Also add a note to the benchmarks page that we reran the throughput tests with seq_len=256; previous numbers were at seq_len=512 which inflated latency. Link should go to /benchmarks/zephyr-mini (fixing the 404).
DocsBot: PR created: <https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/4123> by Alex G — status: draft.
Jun Park: Thx. Can we get a reviewer from infra to sanity-check the compat line? @ProductEng — can you ask infra-sig?
ProductEng: Yep, pinged infra-sig. Also I ran the SDK test locally against a dev image, embedding length matches 768. I'll request changes on the PR for the bench link path and add a unit test that asserts embedding vector length for the example.
Alex G: Will add test and update bench link. Anything else?
Samira: Maybe add a short note in the model card "limits" section: max_input_tokens = 4096 (model-level), and clarify that effective token limit for batch throughput tests was 256 seq per request.
Jun Park: Perfect. After PR lands, can we backport the fix to the archived model catalog redirect pages? A few customers reported cached pages.
DocsBot: Reminder scheduled: deploy-checklist label added to PR.
Alex G: Working on updates now — will mark ready for review once tests pass. :thumbsup:
